usedFor: D-iD generates avatar videos, and Microsoft Excel logs them when “Add Row To Table” follows “New Animation”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Animation” in D-iD, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Each finished animation becomes a row, giving you a running log of what D-iD produced.

watchOut: “New Animation” is polling, and “Add Row To Table” needs an existing Excel table to write into.
